### ⬇ Download
| | File | First launch |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `KARAO-Q-…-win-x64.exe` | If "Windows protected your PC" appears: **More info → Run anyway**. Allow the firewall prompt. |
| **macOS** | `KARAO-Q-…-mac-arm64.dmg` | Drag to Applications, then **right-click → Open** the first time. |
| **Linux** | `KARAO-Q-…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Allow executing (right-click → Properties), then double-click. |

Already have KARAO-Q? Windows and Linux update themselves (they install when you close the app). On Mac, download the new .dmg.
